newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring mixed in extremely light volumes.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring mixed in extremely light volumes.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures were mixed in extremely light midsession dealings, and traders said spring wheat had little direction of its own.
"Our direction is being based exclusively on what's happening in Chicago. It's dead in here," a trader said.
At 1027 CDT, MGE spring wheat was 1/2 cent per bushel lower to 3/4 cent higher, with Dec up 3/4 cents at $4.08-1/2.
Traders said Benson-Quinn bought 200,000 Dec bushels. There were few other names on the players' sheet.
